input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

messages.text: The account says active today. My own laptop was stolen on October 4, 2026. Does the active badge mean that event is inside the policy dates?
Are you asking to change the start date?
No, leave the dates alone. I just need to understand whether the theft date falls in this policy’s interval.

event_date.description: Reported loss date in ISO format.

issued_start.description: Start of the issued coverage interval in ISO format.

event_within_interval.description: Whether starts_on <= event_date < ends_on for the supplied issued policy.
